Sterling Global Strategies Has Increased Apple (AAPL) Stake; Sands Capital Management Cut Stake in Netflix (NFLX) as Stock Price Rose 
January 18, 2018 - By Michael Collier 
Sands Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Netflix Inc (NFLX) by 5.67% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sands Capital Management Llc sold 428,488 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.41% with the market. The institutional investor held 7.13 million shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.29 billion, down from 7.56M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sands Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Netflix Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $94.12B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.82% or $4.03 during the last trading session, reaching $217.5. About 9.12 million shares traded or 47.82% up from the average. Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX) has risen 75.34% since January 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 58.64% the S&P500. 
Sterling Global Strategies Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 96.48% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sterling Global Strategies Llc bought 2,443 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 4,975 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $766,000, up from 2,532 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
